result.title: T2ISpec: Benchmarking Speculative Decoding for Text-to-Image Generation
result.summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generators produce detailed images but remain slow at inference. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost, yet its behavior across the rendering requirements of T2I prompts remains insufficiently understood. We introduce T2ISpec, a benchmark of 1,400 prompts balanced across seven rendering topics and two difficulty levels. It evaluates autoregressive and diffusion/flow accelerators by latency, work performed by the target model, and image quality. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) aggregate results hide large differences between topics, (2) alignment and preference scores can disagree with prompt constraint satisfaction, and (3) large reductions in target work can yield limited latency gains. Motivated by these findings, we propose TopicRoute, a plugin that combines prompt routing with speculative and cache controls without retraining the generator. Across six model--method pairs, it achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.0308x over the native methods, and the speedup carries over to external prompts with the same settings, while quality gains and losses vary across configurations.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 T2ISpec 基准（1400 条提示，覆盖七类渲染主题与两档难度），从延迟、目标模型计算量和图像质量三方面评估 AR 与扩散/流式投机解码，并提出免重训的 TopicRoute 提示路由加缓存控制插件。
AI.relevance_reason: 图像生成不属 VLM 推理主线，但其「目标计算量大幅下降未必带来延迟收益」的成本拆分以及按主题分层的评测方式，可能为 LVR 中投机/缓存加速与动态计算的收益评估提供可供核查的线索。
